crossRefs.note: “So let all your enemies perish, Yahweh, but let those who love him be as the sun when it rises in its strength.” Then…
His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.
Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you…
But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.
“Arise, shine; for your light has come, and Yahweh’s glory has risen on you.
Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your rising.
Violence shall no more be heard in your land, nor desolation or destruction within your borders; but you will call your…
Therefore I have cut them to pieces with the prophets; I killed them with the words of my mouth. Your judgments are…
But to you who fear my name shall the sun of righteousness arise with healing in its wings. You will go out, and leap…
because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the dawn from on high will visit us,
to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to guide our feet into the way of peace.”
The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.
Let’s acknowledge Yahweh. Let’s press on to know Yahweh. As surely as the sun rises, Yahweh will appear. He will come…
My doctrine will drop as the rain. My speech will condense as the dew, as the misty rain on the tender grass, as the…
He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.
In that day, Yahweh’s branch will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the beauty and glory of…
The remnant of Jacob will be among many peoples, like dew from Yahweh, like showers on the grass, that don’t wait for…

translations.web: shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun rises, a morning without clouds, when the tender grass springs out of the earth, through clear shining after rain.’
translations.bsb: is like the light of the morning at sunrise of a cloudless dawn, the glistening after the rain on the sprouting grass of the earth.’
translations.kjv: And he shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, even a morning without clouds; as the tender grass springing out of the earth by clear shining after rain.
translations.asv: He shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, A morning without clouds, When the tender grass springeth out of the earth, Through clear shining after rain.
